test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 4 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that CANNOT be concluded from the statements given below.

Statement 1: All spices are cupboards.

Statement 2: All cupboards are fans.

Statement 3: All doors are cupboards.
solution:
Given statements:

Statement 1: All spices are cupboards.

Statement 2: All cupboards are fans.

Statement 3: All doors are cupboards.

The least possible diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a82de1157282b7eb70b7ba9fa49dc4a0e7691b8c7cf90b7b237b07140ec68e0f.png] 

Option 1) Some fans are doors - True (Because, All doors are cupboards and All cupboards are fans, so Some fans are doors)
